attributes.title: 2027 WVLPCA Annual Spring Conference
attributes.cme_provider: West Virginia Licensed Professional Counselors Association
attributes.organizer: West Virginia Licensed Professional Counselors Association
attributes.summary:
Built with West Virginia renewals in mind: up to 16 CEUs over two days, with sessions on ethics, veterans and the ALPS requirement. Attending virtually saves $91 on the full conference, and single-day tickets suit anyone short only a few hours.

The association is an NBCC approved provider, ACEP No. 6267.  Speakers are not published yet.
